# McDaves Optical

> Nigerian optical materials supplier and premium eyewear brand with over two decades of optical craftsmanship. Est. 1997 in Lagos, Nigeria.

## Overview
- **Brand:** McDaves (incorporating the Sightly handcrafted eyewear line)
- **Founded:** 1997 (Over two decades of precision optical heritage)
- **Headquarters:** 4, Nnamdi Azikwe Street, Lagos, Nigeria
- **Operating Hours:** Monday – Friday, 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM WAT
- **Website:** https://mcdaves.com.ng
- **Contact:** mcdavesopticals@gmail.com | +234 815 234 6649 (Phone & WhatsApp)

## Core Offerings & Services
1. **Sightly Eyewear Collection:**
   - Mid-premium fashion frames designed for the Nigerian market.
   - Handcrafted acetate, stainless steel, and lightweight TR90 materials.
   - Price range: ₦30,000 – ₦80,000.
   - Live AI/3D Virtual Try-On (VTO) available directly on the web.
2. **Prescription Lens Replacement:**
   - Mail-in or drop-off lens replacement service for existing frames.
   - Single vision, Anti-Reflective (AR), Blue-Light Block / Blue-Cut, Photochromic (Light-Adaptive), and Progressive multifocal lenses.
   - 5–7 day turnaround with nationwide delivery.
3. **Wholesale Optical Materials (McDaves B2B / Pro):**
   - Finished lenses, semi-finished surfacing blanks, edging accessories, and optical lab utilities for optometrists, ophthalmologists, and optical store owners across Nigeria.

## Collections & Signature Frames
- **Classic Havana:** Handcrafted acetate round frame (52-18-140) in tortoiseshell pattern — ₦35,000.
- **Lagos Aviator:** Stainless steel aviator frame (58-14-135) with adjustable nose pads — ₦42,000.
- **Ikoyi Cat-Eye:** TR90 lightweight polymer cat-eye frame (50-16-140) — ₦38,000.

## Delivery & Guarantee
- **Lagos Delivery:** 2–5 business days (Free delivery on orders over ₦50,000).
- **Nationwide Delivery:** 5–10 business days across all 36 Nigerian states.
- **Guarantee:** 14-day free lens remake guarantee for prescription accuracy, and 7-day unworn frame exchange.
